dedupe_keys.name: lignes electriques a haute tension du senegal

description: Lignes électriques à Haute Tension du Sénégal is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Africa GeoPortal. Le réseau de transport d’énergie assure l’acheminement de l’électricité en Haute Tension (HT) (90 et 225 kV) des centrales où elle est produite vers les Postes Haute Tension (HT), les gros clients et les réseaux électriques des pays voisins. Coverage: Senegal. The portal files it under the publisher Africa GeoPortal. Its tags are Senegal, Lignes électrique à Haute Tension, Sénégal, Ligne électrique, High voltage. The portal shows 2019-11-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
